examples: SELECT city FROM stores
SELECT unit_cost_eur * 1.21 AS cost_incl_vat FROM products
SELECT city FROM stores WHERE country_code = 'BE'

SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE product_name ILIKE '%pro%'
SELECT city FROM stores ORDER BY city
SELECT city FROM stores ORDER BY city LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT country_code FROM stores

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE store_type = 'outlet') AS outlets FROM stores
SELECT ROUND(CAST(unit_cost_eur AS DOUBLE), 0) AS c FROM products
SELECT date_trunc('month', start_date) AS m FROM promotions
SELECT EXTRACT(month FROM start_date) AS m FROM promotions

SELECT month(start_date) AS m FROM promotions

SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

SELECT LEFT(sku, 2) AS prefix FROM products
SELECT RIGHT(sku, 2) AS suffix FROM products
SELECT start_date + INTERVAL 7 DAY AS d FROM promotions

SELECT date_diff('day', start_date, end_date) AS days FROM promotions
SELECT datediff('day', start_date, end_date) AS days FROM promotions
SELECT date_add(start_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS d FROM promotions
SELECT product_name, SUM(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS brand_cost FROM products
SELECT product_name, SUM(unit_cost_eur) OVER (ORDER BY launch_date) AS running_cost FROM products

SELECT product_name, LAG(unit_cost_eur) OVER (ORDER BY launch_date) AS prev_cost FROM products

SELECT product_name, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur) AS quartile FROM products
SELECT product_name, FIRST_VALUE(unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY launch_date) AS first_cost FROM products
SELECT MEDIAN(unit_cost_eur) AS m FROM products

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur) AS m FROM products
